text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—Wh-!? Huh... Wh-What was that just 
now...!?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...What is this? Deep in my chest, it 
feels so warm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It feels like... power is overflowing...!
